rules.rule_context:
ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE - PROCUREMENT POLICY NOTE

All supply and service purchases with an aggregate order value exceeding $1,000 USD must be sourced from vendors holding current ISO 14001 environmental management system certification. The certification must be active at time of purchase and verified through the procurement registry; expired or pending certifications are treated as absent for the purpose of this requirement. This threshold applies to the total purchase order amount, not to individual line items or vendor invoices. No split orders, phased deliveries, or other structuring to evade the threshold is permitted. Where no certified vendor can fulfill the requirement, the purchase must be escalated to Environmental Compliance before any commitment. Non-certified vendors may be used for orders at or below the $1,000 threshold without additional approval.
